verdict.rationale: Evidence shows solid cross-OS/browser support (Windows control panel, Chromium browsers, macOS/Linux companion app, PIV miniDriver) and manufacturer-agnostic FIDO2.1 tooling, but there is no published catalog listing which third-party services/relying parties are certified compatible with Token2 keys. missing for 10: a published service/RP compatibility catalog, independent cross-browser/OS corroboration beyond vendor docs.
